Group: #9 stands alone. A new implicit basic result builder is created for repeated native queries, but it retains Object identity equality inside the dynamic mapping cache key.

easy-call: supply value equality and a matching hash code based on the immutable suppliedResultClass in ImplicitResultClassBuilder. NativeQueryImpl.resultSetMapping() constructs these builders; ResultSetMappingImpl dynamic equality compares its builder list; SelectInterpretationsKey delegates to the mapping equality. Returning this from cacheKeyInstance is safe for the immutable builder once equality reflects its result class. Distinct classes must remain unequal.

Two-way door: localized internal cache-key correction, no schema, new configuration or public API change. Prefer one production class change and focused integration regression coverage rather than a new abstraction. The reporter already identified the missing equality and supplied a reproduction; attribute that diagnosis and independently reproduce it.

QueryPlanCacheStatisticsTest supplies existing native entity cache coverage and a statistics/reset pattern. Add a dedicated basic native result test or extend this seam: execute separately created same-SQL Long.class queries with different parameter values, assert correct typed IDs and one miss followed by hits. Add same-SQL different-result-class discrimination with correct runtime types. Retain inferred/explicit scalar, named basic and entity controls where useful. Repeated basic class queries and distinct parameter identity reuse are different dimensions; do not undo HHH-20443.
